Mitchell Robinson.note: Robinson (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game versus Milwaukee, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.

Grant Nelson.note: Nelson signed a two-way contract with the Nets on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

Mikel Brown Jr..note: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Egor Demin.note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

Norman Powell.note: Powell (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

Zach Collins.note: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

Sergio de Larrea.note: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

Tarik Biberovic.note: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

Dereck Lively II.note: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

Jalen Duren.note: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

Isaiah Joe.note: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.

Brandon Ingram.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

Isaiah Jackson.note: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

Yanic Konan Niederhauser.note: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

Bradley Beal.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

Jordan Miller.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Luka Doncic.note: Doncic has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit due to lower-back tightness, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.

Gary Trent Jr..note: Trent (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Boston.

Anthony Edwards.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

Donte DiVincenzo.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

Yves Missi.note: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

Adem Bona.note: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.

Dominick Barlow.note: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

Ariel Hukporti.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Keegan Murray.note: Murray (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Heat.

Maxime Raynaud.note: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

Ben Simmons.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

Keyonte George.note: George (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Minnesota.

Lauri Markkanen.note: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.

Jusuf Nurkic.note: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

Jaren Jackson Jr..note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
